She has medium-length damp-looking dark-brown hair and wears a fully buttoned soft-red satin pajama shirt with dark piping and blue cuffs, paired with matching loose satin pants. One arm bends comfortably behind her head while the other rests on the bedding; she gives a soft closed-mouth smile toward the camera. Include a padded fabric headboard, beige and cream pillows, light neutral bedding, and a clean warm-beige bedroom.
